title: DSBSC AM Modulator Passband
text: Modulate using double-sideband suppressed-carrier amplitude modulation, 1 input, 1 output; {Carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency in Hz and {Initial phase (rad)} sets the initial phase offset in radians. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Carrier frequency (Hz)
params.values: Carrier frequency in Hz 300 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial phase (rad)
params.values: Initial phase offset in radians 0 (default) | scalar
